Cluster/shard separation is NOT access control.

the 22 frame(s) the intruder obtained contain no plaintext marker or address (payload sizes [2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197,2197]): ciphertext only. That is the application-layer E2E encryption working, and exactly why cluster/shard separation is not access control: the intruder still learns topics, timing, sizes and sees the traffic of everyone on the shard.
